title: Portable Crystal Processing Table
text: Use the table to open it. The left slot sets the target and the right slot sets the shape. Place an element above, a modifier below, and a Spiritual Crystal in the center.

With the table in your main hand, sneak and use it once. Keep holding it for three seconds as the components converge. The finished low-tier spell crystal drops from the table. Switching away interrupts assembly and keeps the materials.
Assembly costs 20 base mana per spell component, paid on completion. The finished crystal costs the same to cast as one written at a regular Crystal Processing Table.
